diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed that only paths involving web1 were failing. Read web1 state and found eth1 link-up but missing IPv4 address and default route, while leaf2 had DMZ gateway 10.10.40.1/24 configured and ARP reachability to web1 MAC. Added 10.10.40.10/24 to web1 eth1 and added default route via 10.10.40.1. Public success criteria then passed with all lab connectivity checks succeeding.
diagnosis.reference: On web1, interface eth1 lost its IPv4 address: 10.10.40.10/24 was removed, so the interface has no address on the dmz_vlan segment.

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: web1 fails all connectivity checks; eth1 is link-up but has no IPv4 address and no default route, while leaf2 DMZ gateway 10.10.40.1/24 is configured and has ARP reachability to web1 MAC.
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1
